technique_name: Find a recipe for making spicy chai tea.
description: This recipe for spicy chai tea is perfect for a warm, comforting drink. You will need 1 cup of water, 2 bags of black tea, 4 cloves, 4 cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick, 1 teaspoon of freshly grated ginger, 1 tablespoon of honey, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, 1 teaspoon of ground nutmeg, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper.
